company.name: Firmsanad
company.shortDescription: FirmSanad.com is a digital business formation platform helping foreign investors establish companies in Saudi Arabia.
company.description:
FirmSanad.com is a digital platform for foreign investors and companies establishing a legal entity in Saudi Arabia.

The service covers MISA investment licensing, commercial registration, national address registration, Chamber of Commerce membership, VAT and Zakat registration, GOSI, and bank account opening. Clients complete the process online, upload documents once, and track every stage from a single dashboard.

Packages are fixed-price and one-time, from $5,500, with government fees included where applicable. Support is provided in English, Arabic and French.

FirmSanad.com is a product of JMM INNOVATIONS, an independent private company based in Riyadh. It is not a government agency and is not affiliated with any Saudi Arabian government entity. All licenses, registrations and approvals are issued solely by the relevant Saudi authorities.
